messages:
deploybot: [auto] post-deploy: canary expanded to 50% in eu1 for service@v2.3.2. scheduled smoke probes running.

maddie: seeing an uptick in eu1 synth embed probe -> 429s. p95 jumped 1.2s -> 3.4s. 429 rate ~3.2% over last 5m. dashboard: https://dash/re/abc123

ops-bot: alert: synth-embed-eu1 429-rate > 1% (threshold). tagging #eng-releases.

jia: canary %? any config changes in this build?

deploybot: canary at 50%. auto-continue was enabled but will respect manual pause if requested.

sam: digging into inference-proxy logs, seeing:
```
2026-03-20T14:04:12Z inference-proxy eu1 req=abcd status=429 reason=rate_limited tokens=120
2026-03-20T14:04:13Z inference-proxy eu1 req=abce status=200
2026-03-20T14:06:40Z model-server eu1 warn kv_cache_miss=true
```

nate: v2.3.2 included a batching heuristic change (max_batch_window=20ms -> 50ms). could be increasing burst contention.

maddie: health endpoints are fine (200), but /v1/embed returns 429 intermittently under low concurrency.

jia: proposal: hold rollout, pin eu1 to last stable (v2.3.1) while we root cause. any objections?

sam: +1 from me. i'll run a focused smoke with concurrency=5 for 10m and post metrics.

deploybot: action: pause-rollout eu1 service@v2.3.2 -> HOLD. pinned_version=service@v2.3.1 by @jia.

maddie: running smoke (cmd):
```
for i in {1..600}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' https://eu1.api.redwood/infer/embed || echo "err"; sleep 0.5; done
```

maddie: first 2m looked ok, spike recurred at ~4m. p95 and 429 rate attached: https://dash/re/snap456

jia: if 429 > 1% over 5m window on the focused smoke, we rollback/pin to v2.3.1 across eu1. sam/nate to execute.

sam: i'll run the rollback command if threshold met: `/deploy rollback eu1 service@v2.3.1 --force --reason "postdeploy synth 429 spike"` ETA 6-10m after decision.

ops-bot: reminder: create incident ticket and use blameless template if rollback occurs: https://incidents/templates/smoke-failure.

nate: quick note: rollback won't invalidate model KV cache; should be safe. double-checking sidecars for backpressure.

maddie: agreed. after rollback we should re-run canary with smaller increments (10% steps) and tighten synth thresholds.

jia: thanks everyone. tagging oncall: @sam_oncall for follow-up post-rollback if executed. :thumbsup:

sam: ack. will update here with rollout/rollback status and postmortem link if needed. :eyes:
